mapper.update: UPDATE ch_user_product SET order_status = 2 WHERE user_product_id = #{userProductId} AND order_status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT user_product_id, user_id, product_id, product_number, purchase_time, payment_time, order_status, user_product_idempotency_key, create_time, update_time FROM ch_user_product WHERE order_status = 0 AND purchase_time < #{deadline} ORDER BY purchase_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
